home.faq.q1: How long does it take to deliver an enterprise AI project?
home.faq.a1: It depends on the scope: a functional Proof of Concept (POC) is delivered in 2 to 4 weeks, a complete production system in 8 to 12 weeks. We deploy in observable increments for rapid, measurable ROI.
home.faq.q2: How do you guarantee enterprise data security and confidentiality?
home.faq.a2: We systematically execute a mutual NDA, host architectures in GDPR-compliant, sovereign environments, and purge demonstration data within 90 days. Zero client data is ever used for foundation model training.
home.faq.q3: What types of enterprises do you partner with?
home.faq.a3: From high-growth scale-ups to Tier-1 enterprise groups, primarily across Banking & Insurance, Healthcare, Logistics, and Professional Services. We adapt architectures to your digital maturity without imposing disruptive stack rewrites.
home.faq.q4: Do you provide end-to-end digital transformation consulting?
home.faq.a4: Yes — from digital maturity auditing and change management to workflow automation, semantic data warehousing, and enterprise AI governance.
home.faq.q5: What happens during an initial discovery call?
home.faq.a5: A complimentary 30-minute scoping session with a senior architect to understand your challenges, followed by a quantified proposal and sequenced roadmap within 72 hours. Completely non-binding.
